items.title: Represent CertificationWindow and the PRE_CERT receipt as signed gate-consumed process facts
items.context: Create one deep owner, not a thin handler wrapper around review-inventory-epoch.ts. The window has states BLOCKED/ADMITTED/RUNNING/FINALIZED/INVALIDATED/CANCELLED, binds storyId, expected main SHA, headHash, materialHash, storyFilesHash, verifier/test identity, and the inventory epoch/receipt it consumed. Register the artifact and commands in the process-fact registry and process-fact-levels with an explicit gateConsumer. Status must print State, frozen identity, blockers, and exactly one Next command.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop certification_window_status --storyId=B-xxxx prints State: BLOCKED or State: ADMITTED, the frozen head/main/storyFiles hashes when admitted, and exactly one Next: line.

happy.desc: Call certification_window_status --storyId=<id> on a story with a CertificationWindow artifact (or none yet) → stdout contains exactly one 'State:' line whose value is one of BLOCKED|ADMITTED|RUNNING|FINALIZED|INVALIDATED|CANCELLED and exactly one 'Next:' line naming a single recovery/next command. WHY: operator surface from plan Verify; status is the gate-consumed readout, not inventory completeness.

After a successful admit, certification_window_status → prints State: ADMITTED plus the frozen headHash, expected main SHA, and storyFilesHash bound on the signed window. WHY: plan userSees/DoneWhen require frozen identity on the PRE_CERT receipt.

edge.desc: certification_window_status while State is BLOCKED (no successful admit) → does not print an admitted frozen head/main/storyFiles identity as if the candidate were certified; still prints State: BLOCKED and exactly one Next:. WHY: BLOCKED must not impersonate ADMITTED.

certification_window_begin/status/cancel plus the CertificationWindow artifact are registered in process-fact-registry and process-fact-levels with an explicit gateConsumer; npm run test:process-fact-contract exits 0. Status prose never claims a Review Inventory receipt authorizes certification. WHY: process-fact dual contract; inventory completeness is not PRE_CERT.

adversarial.desc: Mutate the on-disk signed CertificationWindow (state, hashes, or inventory receipt id) without going through begin/status/cancel → next status/begin/heavy/DONE consumer fail-closes as tampered/invalid and does not treat the window as ADMITTED. WHY: signed gate-consumed fact; prompt-only status text is not evidence.

Present a FINALIZED Review Inventory receipt (authorizesTest=false / inventory-completeness-only) as if it were a PRE_CERT CertificationWindow → heavy entrypoints and window status still refuse certification authority; inventory hashes are not rewritten. WHY: chosen option A; B-3f3d inventory must never become PRE_CERT.

items.title: Admit PRE_CERT only from existing inventory, merge, clean-tree, and coverage facts
items.context: Begin/admit must fail closed unless: a current Review Inventory epoch is FINALIZED on the same story-files lineage; no open verified blocking findings remain; verification coverage has no missing required intents; local main is an ancestor and expected main SHA is recorded; the worktree is clean of non-runtime material; and a cheap preflight of Git index plus evidence-target writability passes. Reuse B-3f3d finalizedUnconsumedReviewInventory / consume path and done_prepare merge/clean classifiers; do not invent a second freshness hash. Any failure returns a stable blocker code plus the exact recovery command. Keep current strict freshness; do not accept whole-tree drift as fresh.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop certification_window_begin --storyId=B-xxxx refuses with [pre_cert_inventory_not_finalized] or [pre_cert_main_not_merged] or [pre_cert_blocking_findings_open] and Next: names the single recovery command.

happy.desc: certification_window_begin --storyId=<id> when (1) current Review Inventory epoch is FINALIZED on the same storyFilesHash lineage, (2) no open verified blocking findings, (3) required verification coverage has no missing intents, (4) local main is an ancestor and expected main SHA is recorded, (5) worktree is clean of non-runtime material, and (6) Git-index plus evidence-target writability preflight passes → prints State: ADMITTED, frozen head/main/storyFiles hashes, and exactly one Next:. WHY: only full PRE_CERT fact set admits.

Successful admit calls B-3f3d finalizedUnconsumedReviewInventory and consumeReviewInventoryReceipt (no second freshness hash; merge/clean reuse done_prepare classifiers) → the signed window records the consumed inventory epoch/receipt id. WHY: consume existing inventory, do not reimplement epochs.

edge.desc: certification_window_begin when no current FINALIZED Review Inventory exists on this story-files lineage → non-zero exit, stdout/stderr contains [pre_cert_inventory_not_finalized], State is not ADMITTED, and Next: names the single inventory-finalize recovery command. WHY: plan Verify line 1.

certification_window_begin when local main is not an ancestor or expected main SHA is missing → non-zero [pre_cert_main_not_merged], no ADMITTED window, Next: names the single merge/done_prepare recovery command. WHY: plan Verify line 2.

certification_window_begin with an open verified blocking finding → non-zero [pre_cert_blocking_findings_open], no ADMITTED window, Next: names the single finding-recovery command. Dirty non-runtime tree or missing required verification intents likewise fail closed with a stable blocker code (reuse done_prepare clean/coverage classifiers). WHY: plan Verify line 3 plus remaining admit facts.

adversarial.desc: Load the admit path when finalizedUnconsumedReviewInventory / consumeReviewInventoryReceipt are absent (this worktree branched from main without B-3f3d) → begin fail-closes with a stable blocker and never admits. A stub that always returns ADMITTED is a product defect. WHY: decision preMortem 1; no stub-always-admit.

Admit candidate whose materialHash drifted while storyFilesHash is unchanged (whole-tree drift) or whose inventory receipt belongs to another story / another storyFilesHash lineage → refuse; do not treat whole-tree drift as fresh and do not invent a second freshness hash. WHY: keep current strict freshness.

items.title: Refuse official heavy certification unless the current window is ADMITTED or RUNNING
items.context: The choke points are done_required_validate, validate --full, and any command list taken from lattice.config.json doneRequiredCommands. Routine validate without --full, review-preflight slices (--channel/--concept/--lint), and 1-3 minute focused smokes stay outside the window. A heavy start without a current admitted window must not spawn the suite. After admit, the same commands bind their receipts to the frozen window identity.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop done_required_validate --storyId=B-xxxx exits non-zero with [pre_cert_window_required] before any root npm test process starts, and Next: proof-or-stop certification_window_status --storyId=B-xxxx.

items.title: Invalidate the window on source, test, or verifier mutation and keep old receipts fail-closed
items.context: While ADMITTED or RUNNING, material writes to source/test/verifier fail closed or the next status/heavy/DONE consumer persists INVALIDATED with the changed lineage. Story metadata and certification evidence writes remain allowed. Invalidation returns the operator to REVIEW. Stored receipts keep their original hashes; no silent rebind. The window must not block other stories' DEV.
items.userSees: After a source commit inside an ADMITTED window, proof-or-stop certification_window_status --storyId=B-xxxx prints State: INVALIDATED and Next: proof-or-stop story_advance --storyId=B-xxxx --phase=REVIEW.
excludes: Long-lived repo-wide write lock during DEV

items.title: Prove a B-9812-shaped premature heavy run is refused and an admitted window runs at most once
items.context: Add a deterministic replay/smoke that starts from an unfinalized or dirty or unmerged candidate and asserts the heavy entrypoint is refused with zero child suite processes. After a fixture admit, one heavy-path call is allowed. A related story-owned drift after that admit invalidates and a second admit is required. Report heavy_certification_runs and post_cert_source_commits. Do not weaken reviewer-lane or host-quorum counts to make the metric pass.
items.userSees: The focused smoke prints PRE_CERT replay: premature_heavy_runs=0 admitted_heavy_runs=1 post_cert_source_commits=0 and exits 0.
excludes: Claiming the 3-8 hour wall-clock saving without a later A/B story
